scope.summary: Add nullable employee mobile contact storage, E.164 normalization, role-scoped checked writes and People UI; defer SMS consent and delivery.
implemented: Optional mobile contact storage with Australian 04-to-E.164 and syntactic international E.164 normalization.
Server-side validation, checked save/create RPCs, creation idempotency protection and permission tests.
Accessible Add Person and primary-profile edit/remove fields, authorized profile display and user guidance.
Explicit separation of stored contact data from SMS consent, ownership verification and delivery.

criteria.description: Owner/authorized manager can enter an optional mobile number when adding a person and can edit/remove it later in an employee profile.

evidence.outcome: Optional Add Person and edit fields, including removal, are implemented; the browser test was added but could not execute locally.
Focused test stopped before Playwright because the local Next.js build could not fetch Google Fonts.

criteria.description: Existing employees without mobile remain unaffected; Australian and international validation and E.164 persistence are reliable, including invalid/empty inputs and informative errors.

evidence.outcome: Australian input, international E.164, empty input and malformed values are covered by passing tests.
18 focused pgTAP assertions passed, including normalization, invalid input, clearing and creation retries.

criteria.description: Backend migration/actions/RLS enforce correct business, venue and role permissions; unrelated tenants cannot read or change employee phone data.

evidence.outcome: Assertions passed for owner access, out-of-scope manager read/write denial, linked-worker self-read and cross-business denial.
Checked RPCs normalize input and preserve existing authorization checks; mobile values are excluded from audit payloads.

criteria.description: Saving a phone number never sends SMS and does not silently grant SMS consent; future consent/verification/opt-out state is safe and explicitly distinguished.

evidence.outcome: Profile saves only persist contact data; no delivery or consent action is called.
Separately documents explicit consent source/time, independent verification and opt-out enforcement as prerequisites for future SMS.

criteria.description: Targeted database, application, accessibility and browser tests cover creation, editing, removal, negative authorization cases and regression; user guide/help are updated.

evidence.outcome: Passed, 26 tests; guide/help content and existing directory behavior are covered.
Passed, 18 focused pgTAP assertions; local full runner could not build its image because www.postgresql.org DNS resolution failed.
Browser test was not reached because the local build could not fetch Google Fonts.

decisions: Do not add SMS consent, verification or opt-out behavior in this contact-data slice; document these as required separate work before any SMS delivery.
limitations: International validation checks E.164 syntax only; it does not prove carrier assignment or number ownership.
The browser test and complete local pgTAP suite remain unverified in this network-restricted environment.
blockers: PR #277 still needs its description updated with the canonical issue/evidence markers and without auto-close keywords; Verify fails because the description is missing the reference and issue marker.
The focused browser test stopped before Playwright when the local Next.js build could not reach Google Fonts.
